Kapil Sibal proposes changes to anti-defection law

Former Union Law Minister Kapil Sibal has proposed amendments to the Tenth Schedule of the Constitution concerning the anti-defection law. Sibal's proposal aims to prevent party mergers from being used as loopholes for mass defections. The Citizens for Justice and Peace (CJP) has backed Sibal's proposal, advocating for a 20-year ban on defectors.
